avoidRecurringMotifs: open treasure luggage or mimic chests

sites.locator: the warm amber lantern hanging on the left root-covered arch
sites.appearance: a small brass lantern attached to mossy stone
changes: Replace it with a stained-glass moth chapel with a bright cyan window.
Replace it with a large amber hourglass nested in a root fork.
Replace it with a hanging bundle of radiant paper talismans and bells.
Replace it with a brass orrery lantern with three tiny rotating rings.
Replace it with a weathered birdhouse whose doorway emits violet fireflies.

sites.locator: the broad turquoise water channel in the lower-left foreground
sites.appearance: bright flowing cyan water between mossy stone banks
changes: Build a broad submerged mosaic of an open hand holding a moonstone.
Grow a row of giant translucent water-poppies with turquoise centers.
Reveal a line of illuminated stepping stones engraved with tiny runes.
Add a large floating lily-clock with brass hands and glowing petals.
Create a cluster of glossy rainbow snail shells nestled against the bank.

sites.locator: the round bright cyan pool centered beneath the three dark arches
sites.appearance: a wide glowing circular pool with a stone rim
changes: Reveal a sunken circular library table with seven luminous tablet pages beneath clear water.
Place a large stone hand rising from the pool and holding a glowing cube.
Turn the water surface into a calm mirror showing a tiny upside-down night sky.
Build a ring of carved fountain pens standing upright around the pool rim with cyan ink streams.
Reveal a huge clockwork lily whose brass gears are visible under translucent petals.

sites.surface: central stone path below the pool
sites.locator: the empty mossy stone paving directly below the round central pool
sites.appearance: flat gray-green paving stones with small purple mushrooms
changes: Assemble a stack of oversized rune tablets with a bright cyan glyph on the top slab.
Place a broad brass weather vane shaped like a crescent arrow on a stone base.
Create a small printing press with glowing violet type blocks.
Grow an umbrella-shaped fern stand holding three glass ink bulbs.
Build a miniature stone carousel carrying four different colored crystals.

sites.surface: right stone aqueduct above the waterfall
sites.locator: the mossy stone lip immediately above the bright waterfall on the right
sites.appearance: a short cyan-water aqueduct crossing a supported stone ledge
changes: Add a perched stone heron statue with cyan crystal feathers.
Build a tiny root-supported water gauge with a glowing glass column.
Place a brass rain-catcher funnel feeding a violet glass reservoir.
Create a suspended chain of three luminous seed pods over the water.
Add a small wooden signal wheel with brightly painted runic paddles.

sites.locator: the splash basin where the right-hand waterfall meets the lower canal
sites.appearance: a bright cyan waterfall falling into a small round pool
changes: Reveal a broad tiled sunburst beneath the clear splash pool.
Create a semicircle of seven glowing river stones standing upright in the basin.
Grow a thick curtain of pearly hanging water vines at the waterfall base.
Add a giant brass key lying partly submerged with cyan reflections.
Place a shallow round basin filled with luminous folded paper cranes.

sites.locator: the warm lantern mounted on the far-right stone wall above the canal
sites.appearance: a small amber brass lantern attached to masonry
changes: Replace it with an articulated brass arm holding a glowing blue inkwell.
Replace it with a large glass compass filled with drifting amber sand.
Replace it with a root-framed portrait tile whose eyes glow softly violet.
Replace it with a hanging cluster of luminous acorn lanterns.
Replace it with a stone mask with a single teal gem set in its forehead.

sites.locator: the violet mushroom shelf on the upper-left broken stone arch
sites.appearance: small purple fungi and moss attached to a high stone sill
changes: Transform it into a tall fan of curled silver ferns with cyan dew drops.
Add a compact stone typewriter with glowing violet keys.
Build a miniature terrace of stacked books carved from mossy stone.
Create a perched owl-shaped topiary with bright amber eyes.
Add a shallow nest holding three speckled moon eggs.

sites.surface: distant upper stone bridge beyond the pool
sites.locator: the distant high stone bridge silhouetted above the central pool
sites.appearance: a narrow ruined bridge and parapet under a turquoise opening
changes: Erect a compact arch of four floating-looking but visibly bracketed glass letters without readable text.
Place a miniature brass sundial with a long cyan shadow across the parapet.
Build a weathered stone post carrying a large violet lantern flag.
Add a row of three carved stone birds with jewel eyes.
Place a small rolling observatory dome with a slit open to the cave light.

sites.locator: the purple mushroom and moss cluster on the lower-right stone bank
sites.appearance: small purple fungi rooted among dark stone blocks beside water
changes: Create a broad shell-like stone seat with a glowing teal cushion of moss.
Grow a cluster of tall spiral reeds tipped with amber bulbs.
Add a small root-framed stained-glass panel showing abstract cyan shapes.
Build a low pile of polished river pebbles arranged as a crescent mosaic.
Create a squat stone turtle sculpture carrying a violet crystal on its back.
